newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo trims prime/top rates 0.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo trims prime/top rates 0.25 pct.

text.p: Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino said on Thursday it was trimming its prime and top rates by 0.25 percent to 10 percent and 17.5 percent respectively, effective October 28.
The Bank announced the move in a statement in which it noted that it had already cut its top rate to clients by 0.5 percent on August 26.

The latest cut followed a 75 basis point reduction by the Bank of Italy in the discount rate to 7.5 percent from 8.25 percent late on Wednesday, which has prompted a string of other Italian banks to follow suit with cuts in their rates.
